- CWE: CWE-287 CWE-287 Improper Authentication

### CVE-2016-10408 — Improper Access Control in Core.
- Assigner: qualcomm | Published: 2024-11-26 | Updated: 2024-11-26 | Max CVSS: 7.8
- CWE: CWE-284 CWE-284 Improper Access Control
- CVSS 3.1 (cna): 7.8 HIGH `CVSS:3.1/AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=none, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=total

QSEE will randomly experience a fatal error during execution due to speculative instruction fetches from device memory. Device memory is not valid executable memory.

Affected:
- Qualcomm, Inc. / Snapdragon: affected 9206 LTE Modem; affected APQ8037; affected SD626; affected SD820; affected SD821
